text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day at summer camp, during our

post-training free time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Air Groove looking concerned over
in the
break area. On the table in front
of her are some
pens and a notepad.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good timing. I want your opinion on
something.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Look at this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the notebook that Air Groove
had been
staring at. It looks like she's
been working on a
training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's quite intense in volume and
difficulty, but a
lot of it seems
surprisingly basic by Air Groove's

standards.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, this is for the Umamusume joining
summer
camp for the first time next year.
choice_data_list: Is this a menu made for Air Groove?
Is this a menu for Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I designed it for students who don't have
a trainer
of their own, or who wish to
supplement their
assigned training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be useful to have such
a
template available, so that the
younger
Umamusume know how best to
utilize their time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To think that Air Groove has been
considering
the needs of future camp
participants, even when
she has her own
training for the Shuka Sho to
attend to...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Touched by the depth of her concern for
others, I
decide to help her out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's already this late...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we realize it, it's already time for
lights
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Over the past few hours, we've turned
the one
regimen into many, each
targeting a certain area
to work on.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, not too shabby. Not that I would
expect any
less from my trainer, mind
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. You should get to bed
promptly
tonight. We have an early start
tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Good work to you too, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, after the end of the
group
training session...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There you are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to test out the training
regimens we
wrote up yesterday. Let's
go.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What are you so surprised about? Do
you really
expect me to recommend a
training regimen I
haven't trialed myself?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We have a responsibility as the creators
to make
sure these regimens are perfect.
I am shocked
that this even needs
explanation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. What exactly is it
that you
take me for? This benefits you
as well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is the perfect opportunity to do
some
focused training in preparation for
the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove flashes a disarming smile that
leaves
no room for argument.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Right. I'll have you pick. Which of the
regimens
from yesterday would you like
to practice?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the regimen that focuses on
essential strength
training, reinforcing
muscles throughout the
body.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we'll need to test this one carefully
to ensure
it's properly balanced. Very
well, let's do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm itching to begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the setting sun on our backs, Air
Groove
and I test run the new training
regimen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew! Yes, this regimen is great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's clearly a tough workout, but Air
Groove
manages it without so much as a
complaint. I
wouldn't expect any less of
her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She's always giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why she's capable of aiming for
the Triple
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I think I know what I need to do!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not bad—but I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Air Groove continues her diligent
training, a
small crowd of younger
Umamusume gather to
watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's evident that each and every one of
them are
in awe of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove eventually finishes up the
training
regimen without a single
misstep.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A full-out shuttle run on the beach that
feels like
a sprint to hell and back... Yes,
the simplicity of
this one is precisely
what makes it the biggest
trial of
willpower.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little surprised you chose this one.
Still, it'll
make for good training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right. I expect you to help make this
even
tougher for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If my pace drops—even by a
little—before I reach
the target number
of laps, you need to get me
back on
track.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep an eye on my energy and push me
right to
my limits. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just so we're clear, I intend to go faster
than
whatever you're imagining. Treat
this like a
life-or-death contest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We begin the "Forged in the Fires of
Hell"
regimen, and Air Groove's pace
eventually begins
to drop as she racks
up repetitions.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Not if I can help it!
choice_data_list: You're a tenth of a second slower!
You're a tenth of a second slower!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gives a smirk and ups her
pace. I'm
left in awe at her guts and
unwillingness to quit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She's always seeking to reach greater
heights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why she's capable of aiming for
the Triple
Tiara so confidently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I think I know what I need to do!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course not!
choice_data_list: Is that really as far as your limits go?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Air Groove pushes herself to her
limits, a small
crowd of younger
Umamusume gather to watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's evident that each and every one of
them are
in awe of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the enraptured crowd looks on, Air
Groove
spectacularly achieves her rep
target.
